summary: Compiled all 14 user-supplied therapy-consult profiles into concise Rust-owned perspective prompts without embedding the oversized persona-simulation prompts.

Revised the shared contract for a licensed mental-health professional: clinically specific formulation, differentials, target selection, sequencing, intervention, contraindication, and monitoring replace consumer-facing safety boilerplate.
Replaced person-name seat identities with descriptive lens names while retaining explicit public-work attribution and non-impersonation language.
Added four calm built-in Dream Team presets that cover all 14 perspectives under the four-seat native runtime limit.

Added professional response discipline requiring clinically specific formulation, discriminating assessment questions, sequencing, targets, interventions, contraindications, monitoring, and a principal blind spot.
Calibrated evidence claims so EMDR is distinguished from emerging or limited-evidence IFS, Somatic Experiencing, FSAP, DeTUR, and DNMS claims without injecting ritual caveats into every answer.
Kept built-ins out of the encrypted user database, avoiding writes and secret-store access merely to list the library.
Proved that persona prompt revisions cannot reuse a token-incompatible cached prefix.
